## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Consumer Discretionary weakness vs Staples (XLY 1W: -3.28% | 1M: +3.34% in CORRECTION vs XLP proxy Consumer Stpl. 1W: +0.21% | 1M: +3.08%), and credit stress flagged (HYG 1W: -0.09% | 1M: +2.51% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.67% | 1M: +1.72% CORRECTION) alongside narrow sector participation despite VXX (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -21.11%) BELOW TREND complacency.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD signaled strain (HYG 1W: -0.09% | 1M: +2.51% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.67% | 1M: +1.72% CORRECTION). Narrow leadership: XLK (1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18%) ABOVE TREND concentrated the gains while broad sector participation remains weak.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral to tightening: SPY/TLT showing strength (SPY 1W: +0.91% | 1M: +10.86% ABOVE TREND vs TLT 1W: -0.88% | 1M: +0.60% CORRECTION) but Dollar direction muted (Dollar strength level tracked; UUP 1W: +0.48% | 1M: -1.29% RECOVERY) and yield/credit noise keeping conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading but narrow: XLK (1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +38.49%) ABOVE TREND are top performers; Energy bifurcated with BNO (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND while XLE (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -7.72%) in RECOVERY. Style: Growth/concentration leadership amid weak breadth.

5. US vs Global?
US holding up: SPY (1W: +0.91% | 1M: +10.86%) ABOVE TREND while EM strength is visible in EEM (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +14.73%) ABOVE TREND; China softness persists with FXI (1W: -3.21% | 1M: +4.35%) in CORRECTION and China tech notably lagging.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: IBIT (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +12.21%) ABOVE TREND shows crypto interest, but small caps/active speculation is in correction — IWM (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +12.00%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -3.49% | 1M: +13.59%) CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Oil-driven reflation pockets: USO (1W: +11.05% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial metals mixed with CPER (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +10.80%) in CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed-to-strong: XLE (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -7.72%) RECOVERY while BNO (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas weakness persists with UNG (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -11.40%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed narrow leadership: XLK and semiconductor complex (XLK 1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18% ABOVE TREND; SOXX 1W: +9.07% | 1M: +38.49% ABOVE TREND). Divergences: multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches (ARKK, IWM, SLV, CPER) constitute a MAJOR divergence signal — suppresses broad risk-on conviction despite concentrated gains.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor defensive posture and liquidity: reduce exposure to broad cyclical beta and monitor concentrated tech exposure (XLK 1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18% ABOVE TREND). Bonds and quality proxies to be watched as conditions can reprice quickly given credit signal.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18%) ABOVE TREND if semis momentum (SOXX 1W: +9.07% | 1M: +38.49%) persists. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +3.34%) CORRECTION and Healthcare XLV (1W: -2.69% | 1M: -1.56%) BELOW TREND on defensive rotation.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Crude/Brent via BNO (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +5.95%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +11.05% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -11.40%) BELOW TREND and select metals showing short-term profit taking (SLV 1W: -5.29% | 1M: +12.44% CORRECTION).

13. Key Levels?
VXX 28.9 (VXX 1W: -1.50% | 1M: -21.11% BELOW TREND) — complacency if moves lower toward 20; HYG/LQD ratio ~0.7367 (credit stress signaled; HYG 1W: -0.09% | 1M: +2.51% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.67% | 1M: +1.72% CORRECTION); SPY/TLT 8.29 (SPY 1W: +0.91% | 1M: +10.86% ABOVE TREND; TLT 1W: -0.88% | 1M: +0.60% CORRECTION); Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, credit stress flagged (HYG 1W: -0.09% | 1M: +2.51% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.67% | 1M: +1.72% CORRECTION) and defensives outperforming cyclicals. Tech and semiconductors are showing strength (XLK 1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18% ABOVE TREND; SOXX 1W: +9.07% | 1M: +38.49% ABOVE TREND) while multiple 1W/1M divergences (ARKK 1W: -3.49% | 1M: +13.59% CORRECTION; IWM 1W: -0.08% | 1M: +12.00% CORRECTION) are the key risk to monitor.
